qs.q: Which soil conservation practice involves planting alternating strips of erosion-resisting leguminous cover crops and clean-tilled row crops across a slope?
qs.e: Strip cropping interrupts overland water flow down slopes by placing dense cover crop bands between row crop fields.

qs.q: Which bacterial disease of poultry causes whitish diarrhea, high chick mortality, and focal liver necrosis, caused by Salmonella pullorum?
qs.e: Pullorum disease is an egg-transmitted bacterial infection caused by Salmonella pullorum causing severe white diarrhea in chicks.

qs.q: Which digestive enzyme secreted in pancreatic juice hydrolyzes dietary fats and lipids into fatty acids and glycerol?
qs.e: Lipase breaks down emulsified fat triglycerides into free fatty acids and monoglycerides in the small intestine.

qs.q: A broiler flock of 200 birds consumed 500 kg of feed over 6 weeks and gained 200 kg total live weight. Calculate Feed Conversion Ratio.
qs.e: FCR = Total Feed Consumed / Total Weight Gain = 500 kg / 200 kg = 2.50.

qs.q: Calculate the price elasticity of supply if a 20% increase in market price of cocoa leads to a 10% increase in quantity supplied.
qs.e: Elasticity of Supply = (% Change in Q / % Change in P) = 10% / 20% = 0.50, indicating price-inelastic agricultural supply.

qs.q: Which group extension method involves holding an open educational event on a model farm where farmers tour demonstration plots?
qs.e: A field day invites local farmers to tour demonstration plots, examine crop performance, and exchange ideas with researchers.

qs.q: Which surveying instrument features a telescope mounted on a tripod equipped with a bubble level to determine relative elevations between ground points?
qs.e: A dumpy level measures horizontal sight lines to establish ground elevations, contours, and drainage slopes.

qs.q: Which viral disease transmitted by whiteflies causes leaf curling, golden vein yellowing, and severe stunting in tomato crops?
qs.e: TYLCV is a Begomovirus spread by Bemisia tabaci causing upward leaf curling, chlorosis, and flower drop in tomatoes.

qs.q: Which silvicultural practice involves removing competing weed vines, shrubs, and inferior tree species around crop trees in young forest plantations?
qs.e: Cleaning removes climbers and unwanted woody competition around valuable crop saplings during early plantation establishment.

qs.q: Why is an overflow spillway constructed on the embankment dyke of an earthen fish pond?
o: To trap wild predatory fish entering the pond
To release excess floodwater safely and prevent dyke erosion or overtopping during heavy rains
qs.e: Spillways allow heavy floodwaters to bypass pond dykes safely without washing away earth structures or fish stocks.

qs.q: A farmer plants sweet potato at a spacing of 1.0 m by 0.25 m on 2 hectares. Calculate total vine cuttings required.
qs.e: Stand area = 1.0 m x 0.25 m = 0.25 sq m. Cuttings/ha = 10,000 / 0.25 = 40,000. Total for 2 ha = 2 x 40,000 = 80,000 cuttings.

qs.q: Formulate 500 kg of a 18% CP poultry grower ration using Maize (9% CP) and Groundnut Cake (41% CP). Calculate the mass of Groundnut Cake needed.
qs.e: Maize (9) vs 18 = 23 parts GNC. GNC (41) vs 18 = 9 parts Maize. Total = 32. GNC fraction = 9 / 32 = 0.28125. For 500 kg = 0.28125 x 500 = 140.6 kg.

qs.q: A herd of 10 beef steers consumed 6,000 kg total dry matter feed over 100 days and gained 600 kg total live weight. Calculate Feed Conversion Ratio.
qs.e: FCR = Total Feed Consumed / Total Weight Gain = 6,000 kg / 600 kg = 10.0.

qs.q: A farm tractor purchased for 6,000,000 Naira has a useful life of 8 years and a salvage value of 600,000 Naira. Calculate annual straight-line depreciation.
qs.e: Annual Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage Value) / Lifespan = (6,000,000 - 600,000) / 8 = 675,000 Naira.

qs.q: Why is a boom sprayer equipped with flat fan nozzles preferred over cone nozzles when applying broadcast pre-emergence herbicides?
o: Flat fan nozzles operate without liquid pressure
Cone nozzles consume double the chemical volume
Flat fan nozzles produce fog mists that drift away
Flat fan nozzles produce a uniform fan-shaped spray sheet with even volume distribution across the boom width
qs.e: Flat fan nozzles deliver a tapered flat spray pattern that overlaps uniformly across spray booms for herbicide coverage.

qs.q: Which beetle pest infests stored yam chips and cassava chips, whose adults and larvae bore tunnels leaving powdery flour frass?
qs.e: Prostephanus truncatus is a destructive bostrichid wood-boring beetle attacking stored maize, dried cassava, and yam chips.

qs.q: A forester plants Gmelina arborea at 3.0 m by 3.0 m spacing on a 6-hectare plantation. Calculate total seedlings required.
qs.e: Area = 6 ha = 60,000 sq m. Area per seedling = 3.0 x 3.0 = 9 sq m. Seedlings = 60,000 / 9 = 6,666.7 ~ 6,667 seedlings.

qs.q: An earthen fish pond measuring 800 square metres is stocked with catfish fingerlings at 5 per m2. Calculate total fingerlings required.
qs.e: Total fingerlings = Pond Area x Stocking Rate = 800 sq m x 5 fingerlings/sq m = 4,000 fingerlings.

qs.q: How many kilograms of Triple Superphosphate (46% P2O5) are required to supply 69 kg of P2O5 per hectare to a cowpea plot?
qs.e: Mass of TSP required = Target P2O5 / Fraction P2O5 = 69 kg / 0.46 = 150 kg.

qs.q: A lamb weighing 4.0 kg at birth reaches 32 kg live weight at 120 days of age. Calculate its average daily weight gain (ADG).
qs.e: Total gain = 32 - 4 = 28 kg. ADG = 28 kg / 120 days = 0.233 kg/day.

qs.q: Which fungal disease causes leaf spots, stem lesions, and boll anthracnose in cotton crops, caused by Colletotrichum gossypii?
qs.e: Colletotrichum gossypii causes cotton anthracnose, producing dark lesions on leaves, stems, and bolls.

qs.q: A 100 g soil sample has a CEC of 18 meq/100g and contains 10.8 meq of exchangeable bases. Calculate base saturation percentage.
qs.e: Base Saturation % = (Exchangeable Bases / CEC) x 100 = (10.8 / 18) x 100 = 60%.

qs.q: A dairy cow producing 25 L of milk daily requires 1.25 kg DCP for milk production. If maintenance DCP requirement is 0.50 kg, calculate total daily DCP required.
qs.e: Total DCP = Maintenance (0.50 kg) + Production (1.25 kg) = 1.75 kg DCP per day.

qs.q: Calculate the book value of a feed processing plant purchased for 3,000,000 Naira after 2 years using declining balance depreciation at 20% per annum.
qs.e: Yr 1 Book Value = 3m x 0.80 = 2,400,000; Yr 2 Book Value = 2.4m x 0.80 = 1,920,000 Naira.

qs.q: A fish pond holding 2,500 cubic metres of water is treated with agricultural lime at 40 g per m3. Calculate total lime required.
A forest valuation survey records 300 m3/ha standing timber across 40 hectares. If timber royalty is 15,000 Naira per m3, calculate total royalty revenue.
qs.e: Total Volume = 300 m3/ha x 40 ha = 12,000 m3. Total Royalty = 12,000 m3 x 15,000 Naira/m3 = 180,000,000 Naira.

qs.q: Which major cereal crop produces male flowers on a terminal tassel and female flowers on lateral ears (cobs)?
qs.e: Zea mays is a monoecious crop bearing separate male staminate flowers on terminal tassels and female pistillate ears on lower nodes.

qs.q: Which soil physical property reflects the total volume of pore space unoccupied by solid mineral or organic matter?
qs.e: Soil porosity expresses the percentage of total soil volume occupied by air and water pore spaces.

qs.q: What term refers to a mature male pig kept for breeding purposes in a swine herd?
qs.e: A boar is an intact mature male pig utilized for herd sire breeding duties.

qs.q: Which economic principle states that as additional units of a farm product are consumed, the satisfaction derived from each additional unit declines?
qs.e: Diminishing marginal utility states that incremental satisfaction gained from consuming additional units of a good decreases.

qs.q: Which farm tool consists of a flexible metal rake head used to collect fallen leaves, grass cuttings, and small debris from farm lawns?
qs.e: A garden rake features tines mounted on a bar used for leveling soil beds and gathering loose plant debris.

qs.q: What name is given to the aquatic plant species rooted or floating on the surface of fish ponds?
qs.e: Macrophytes are macroscopic aquatic plants (e.g. water hyacinth, duckweed, water lily) inhabiting pond ecosystems.

qs.q: Which forestry system involves growing timber trees in combination with agricultural crops and livestock on the same land unit?
qs.e: Agrosilvopastoral systems integrate crops, trees, and livestock simultaneously on a single land holding.

qs.q: Which fiber crop produces coarse stem bast fibers harvested by retting stems in water for rope and gunny sack production?
qs.e: Corchorus olitorius yields bast stem fibers extracted via water retting for manufacturing burlap bags and ropes.

qs.q: Which high-protein trailing legume forage, commonly called Centro, is widely grown in mixed pastures with Guinea grass?
qs.e: Centrosema pubescens (Centro) is a palatable trailing legume providing nitrogen-rich forage in tropical pastures.

qs.q: Which essential plant nutrient is an integral constituent of cell walls, activating enzyme systems and regulating stomatal closure?
qs.e: Potassium regulates guard cell turgor pressure for stomatal opening/closing and activates metabolic transport enzymes.

qs.q: Which surface irrigation method involves flooding a level rectangular field enclosed by low earth dikes, commonly used for lowland paddy rice?
qs.e: Basin irrigation floods level earthen basins enclosed by dikes, ideal for crops like paddy rice requiring impounded water.

qs.q: Which dairy cattle breed originating from the English Channel Islands produces milk with a high butterfat content and distinct golden color?
qs.e: Jersey cattle produce rich milk averaging over 5% butterfat content, giving it a rich yellow color.

qs.q: Which poultry routine management operation involves placing permanent metal or plastic numbered bands around the legs of breeding birds?
qs.e: Leg banding fits identification rings onto bird legs to track pedigree records and individual layer performance.

qs.q: Which agricultural economic term describes a market scenario where a few large firms control the total supply of a farm input?
qs.e: An oligopoly market features a small number of dominant suppliers influencing prices and supply terms.

qs.q: In farm accounting, what financial statement shows all projected cash inflows and cash outflows expected over a future farming season?
qs.e: A cash flow budget forecasts monthly cash receipts and disbursements to plan liquidity and operating credit requirements.

qs.q: Which component of an internal combustion engine regulates the flow of air-fuel mixture into combustion cylinders and exhaust gases out?
qs.e: Intake and exhaust valves opened by the camshaft control fuel-air entry and exhaust gas discharge during engine cycles.

qs.q: Which piercing and sucking insect pest attacks cowpea pods, sucking sap from developing seeds and causing shriveled, deformed pods?
qs.e: Clavigralla tomentosicollis nymphs and adults pierce cowpea pod walls to suck seed sap, causing severe yield loss.

qs.q: Which fast-growing exotic timber tree species, commonly called Teak, belongs to the family Lamiaceae and yields durable hardwood?
qs.e: Tectona grandis (Teak) produces prized, weather-resistant timber rich in natural oils, widely grown in West Africa.

qs.q: Which pond management practice involves applying agricultural limestone (CaCO3) to neutralize bottom soil acidity and stabilize water pH?
qs.e: Liming neutralizes soil acidity, raises total alkalinity, and buffers water pH between 6.5 and 8.5 for healthy fish growth.

qs.q: Which crop husbandry operation involves removing excess weak or crowded seedlings from a stand to leave the recommended plant population?
qs.e: Thinning removes overcrowded or sickly seedlings early in crop growth to eliminate inter-plant competition.

qs.q: Which specialized underground horizontal stem produces roots and shoots at its nodes, as seen in ginger and spear grass?
qs.e: A rhizome is a thick underground horizontal stem storing food reserves and bearing nodes that produce aerial shoots.

qs.q: A farmer plants cowpea on 2.5 hectares at a spacing of 0.75 m by 0.20 m with 1 seed per stand. Calculate total seed stands.
Which soil physical property describes the resistance of soil to deformation or rupture under applied mechanical pressure at varying moisture levels?
qs.e: Soil consistency evaluates soil cohesion and plasticity when wet, moist, or dry (e.g. friable, firm, sticky).

qs.q: How many kilograms of pure Potassium (K2O) are supplied by applying 200 kg of NPK 15-15-15 compound fertilizer?
qs.e: NPK 15-15-15 contains 15% K2O. Mass of K2O supplied = 15% of 200 kg = 0.15 x 200 = 30.0 kg.

qs.q: Which soil conservation practice involves planting trees and shrubs across slopes along contour lines to trap sediment and slow runoff?
qs.e: Contour hedgerows act as living vegetative barriers planted along elevation contours to filter runoff and retain topsoil.

qs.q: Which acute viral disease of cattle and buffaloes causes high fever, mucosal erosions in the mouth, dysentery, and high mortality, eradicated globally?
qs.e: Rinderpest was a devastating Morbillivirus infection causing mucosal necrosis and severe bloody diarrhea, officially eradicated worldwide.

qs.q: Which chamber of the ruminant stomach absorbs water, residual volatile fatty acids, and bicarbonate from ingested food mass?
qs.e: The omasum features leaf-like muscular folds that squeeze out water, VFAs, and electrolytes prior to true stomach digestion.

qs.q: A layer farm of 400 hens produces 320 eggs daily while consuming 48 kg of feed. Calculate the feed consumed per egg produced.
qs.e: Feed per egg = Total Feed / Total Eggs = 48 kg / 320 eggs = 0.15 kg (150 grams) per egg.

qs.q: If a farmer's total revenue from selling yam is 1,500,000 Naira and variable costs are 900,000 Naira, calculate the gross margin.
qs.e: Gross Margin = Total Revenue - Total Variable Costs = 1,500,000 - 900,000 = 600,000 Naira.

qs.q: Which group extension method involves teaching a group of farmers step-by-step how to perform a new practical skill like budding or spraying?
qs.e: A method demonstration shows farmers 'how to do' a specific job step-by-step so they can practice and master the skill.

qs.q: Which surveying tool consists of a flexible steel ribbon enclosed in a casing used for measuring distances along survey lines?
qs.e: A measuring tape (steel or fiberglass tape) provides precise linear distance measurements during farm land surveys.

qs.q: Which viral disease transmitted by aphids causes dark green vein-banding, leaf curling, and severe yield reduction in pepper crops?
qs.e: PVMV is a Potyvirus spread by aphids causing vein banding, mottling, and fruit distortion in peppers.

qs.q: Which agroforestry system combines short-term arable crop farming with long-term forest tree plantation establishment on state forest land?
qs.e: The Taungya system grants farmers access to cleared forest reserve land to grow annual food crops alongside young timber saplings.

qs.q: Why is organic fertilizer (such as poultry manure or cow dung) applied to fish ponds before filling with water?
o: To prevent pond water seepage completely
To clear water transparency to 100 cm
To release organic nutrients that stimulate rapid blooms of phytoplankton and zooplankton
qs.e: Organic manures decompose in pond water, releasing nitrogen and phosphorus that trigger natural plankton blooms for fish feeding.

qs.q: A farmer plants cassava at 1.0 m by 0.8 m spacing on 2 hectares. Calculate total cassava cuttings required.
qs.e: Stand area = 1.0 m x 0.8 m = 0.8 sq m. Cuttings/ha = 10,000 / 0.8 = 12,500. Total for 2 ha = 2 x 12,500 = 25,000 cuttings.

qs.q: Using Pearson Square, calculate the mass of Cotton Seed Cake (36% CP) required to formulate 250 kg of a 16% CP cattle supplement using Yellow Maize (8% CP).
qs.e: Maize (8) vs 16 = 20 parts CSC. CSC (36) vs 16 = 8 parts Maize. Total = 28. CSC fraction = 8 / 28 = 0.2857. For 250 kg = 0.2857 x 250 = 71.4 kg.

qs.q: A herd of 8 beef steers consumed 4,800 kg dry matter feed over 80 days and gained 480 kg total live weight. Calculate Feed Conversion Ratio.
qs.e: FCR = Total Feed Consumed / Total Weight Gain = 4,800 kg / 480 kg = 10.0.

qs.q: A poultry housing facility costing 4,000,000 Naira depreciates at a fixed rate of 350,000 Naira per year. Calculate its book value after 5 years.
qs.e: Accumulated Depreciation = 5 x 350,000 = 1,750,000 Naira. Book Value = 4,000,000 - 1,750,000 = 2,250,000 Naira.

qs.q: Why is a disc harrow preferred over a spike-tooth harrow for seedbed preparation on land heavily covered with plant residues?
o: It requires no tractor PTO power or hydraulic lift
It operates at zero draft resistance
Its rotating sharp steel discs cut and chop tough plant residues while mixing them into topsoil
qs.e: Disc harrows utilize rotating concave steel discs that slice through thick crop residues and clods effectively.

qs.q: Which caterpillar pest attacks pods of cowpea and pigeon pea, boring entrance holes and consuming internal seeds?
qs.e: Maruca vitrata larvae web together floral buds, leaves, and pods, feeding internally on seeds.

qs.q: A silviculturist plants Khaya ivorensis seedlings at 4.0 m by 4.0 m spacing on a 10-hectare forest estate. Calculate total seedlings required.
qs.e: Area = 10 ha = 100,000 sq m. Area per seedling = 4.0 x 4.0 = 16 sq m. Seedlings required = 100,000 / 16 = 6,250 seedlings.

qs.q: An earthen fish pond measuring 1,200 square metres is stocked with Tilapia fingerlings at 4 per m2. Calculate total fingerlings required.
qs.e: Total fingerlings = Pond Area x Stocking Density = 1,200 sq m x 4 fingerlings/sq m = 4,800 fingerlings.

qs.q: How many kilograms of Muriate of Potash (60% K2O) are required to supply 120 kg of K2O per hectare to an oil palm estate?
qs.e: Mass of MOP required = Target K2O / Fraction K2O = 120 kg / 0.60 = 200 kg.

qs.q: A piglet weighing 1.2 kg at birth reaches 84 kg live weight at 160 days of age. Calculate its average daily weight gain (ADG).
qs.e: Total gain = 84 - 1.2 = 82.8 kg. ADG = 82.8 kg / 160 days = 0.5175 ~ 0.518 kg/day.

qs.q: Which bacterial pathogen causes soft rot of stored yam tubers and potato tubers, converting internal tissues into foul-smelling liquid sludge?
qs.e: Pectobacterium carotovorum produces pectolytic enzymes that break down cell wall middle lamellae, causing soft wet rot in tubers.

qs.q: A soil sample has a total cation exchange capacity of 20 meq/100g. If exchangeable Al3+ = 4 meq and H+ = 2 meq per 100g, calculate the base saturation percentage.
qs.e: Exchangeable bases = CEC - Acid Cations = 20 - (4 + 2) = 14 meq/100g. Base Saturation % = (14 / 20) x 100 = 70%.

qs.q: A high-producing dairy cow consuming 15 kg dry matter feed daily achieves a daily milk yield of 25 L. Calculate her feed efficiency in Litres of milk per kg dry matter intake.
qs.e: Milk Feed Efficiency = Milk Yield / DM Intake = 25 Litres / 15 kg DM = 1.67 L/kg DM.

qs.q: Calculate the compound interest accrued on a 1,000,000 Naira agricultural loan borrowed at 10% per annum compounded annually over 3 years.
An intensive fish culture pond holding 3,000 cubic metres of water is treated with copper sulphate at 0.2 mg/L as an algicide. Calculate total copper sulphate required.
A forest timber inventory estimates a merchantable stand volume of 220 m3/ha across a 30-hectare woodlot. Calculate total stand timber volume.
qs.e: Total Timber Volume = Volume per hectare x Total Area = 220 m3/ha x 30 ha = 6,600 cubic metres.

qs.q: Which of the following farm tools is primarily used for transplanting seedlings from nursery beds into the main field?
qs.e: A hand trowel is a small handheld tool designed specifically for scooping soil and transplanting delicate seedlings without damaging root balls.

qs.q: What is the term given to the practice of planting forest trees simultaneously with food crops on the same piece of land?
qs.e: The Taungya system allows farmers to grow agricultural crops alongside forest tree seedlings during the early years of forest plantation establishment.

qs.q: Which nutrient deficiency in crop plants typically causes interveinal chlorosis in younger leaves due to its immobility within plant tissues?
qs.e: Iron is immobile in plants; hence deficiency symptoms such as interveinal chlorosis appear first on young apical leaves.

qs.q: Which fish species is widely cultured in tropical African fish ponds due to its rapid growth rate, air-breathing organ, and high market value?
qs.e: Clarias gariepinus (African catfish) possesses a suprabranchial accessory breathing organ allowing it to thrive in low-oxygen pond environments.

qs.q: Which vector insect is responsible for transmitting the trypanosome parasite that causes nagana disease in cattle?
qs.e: Tsetse flies (Glossina species) act as biological vectors for Trypanosoma parasites, causing nagana in livestock and sleeping sickness in humans.

qs.q: What is the principal method of propagating cassava (Manihot esculenta) commercially on farms?
qs.e: Cassava is vegetatively propagated using mature hardwood stem cuttings (stakes) bearing several viable nodes.

qs.q: In agricultural economics, fixed costs are best defined as costs that:
o: do not change with variations in the level of production output.
equal marginal revenue at peak output.
qs.e: Fixed costs (e.g. land rent, machinery depreciation) remain constant in total regardless of the quantity of goods produced.

qs.q: A soil sample has a total volume of 100 cm3 and a dry mass of 130 g. What is the bulk density of this soil sample?
qs.e: Bulk density = Dry mass / Total volume = 130 g / 100 cm3 = 1.30 g/cm3.

qs.q: Which process in the nitrogen cycle converts soil ammonium ions into nitrites and subsequently into nitrates by autotrophic bacteria?
qs.e: Nitrification involves two stages: Nitrosomonas bacteria oxidize ammonium to nitrite, and Nitrobacter bacteria oxidize nitrite to nitrate.

qs.q: Which tractor-drawn implement is specifically used to break up hardpans below normal plowing depth without turning over the topsoil layer?
qs.e: A subsoiler features heavy-duty tines designed to shatter compacted subsoil layers (hardpans) up to 60 cm deep without inversion.

qs.q: What is the primary function of adding agricultural quicklime (calcium oxide) or slaked lime to acidic farm soils?
o: To raise soil pH and reduce toxic concentrations of aluminum and manganese
To decrease soil pH and increase solubility of iron
To increase soil salinity and reduce water infiltration
To sterilize the soil against all beneficial bacteria
qs.e: Liming neutralizes soil acidity by replacing exchangeable hydrogen and aluminum ions with calcium, raising soil pH to optimal levels.

qs.q: In cattle management, what is the term given to the act of removing horns from young calves to prevent injury to farm workers and herd mates?
qs.e: Disbudding is the destruction or removal of horn-producing cells in young calves before the horn bud attaches to the skull bone.

qs.q: Which plant disease is caused by the fungus Phytophthora palmivora and causes severe pods destruction in cocoa plantations?
qs.e: Black pod disease of cocoa is caused by Phytophthora species, leading to brown lesions that rapidly rot the entire cocoa pod.

qs.q: Calculate the dressing percentage of a steer with a live weight of 400 kg and a dressed carcass weight of 220 kg.
qs.e: Dressing percentage = (Dressed carcass weight / Live weight) * 100 = (220 / 400) * 100 = 55.0%.

qs.q: An agro-forestry system that integrates forest tree species with pasture grasses and grazing livestock is classified as:
qs.e: A silvopastoral system deliberately combines forestry tree management with forage production and animal grazing on the same land unit.

qs.q: What is the recommended stocking density range for rearing Clarias catfish fingerlings in an earthen pond with basic water exchange?
qs.e: For standard earthen fish ponds without intensive aeration, stocking 5 to 10 catfish fingerlings per square meter ensures adequate growth and oxygen levels.

qs.q: If the price of maize increases from 200 Naira to 250 Naira per kg and the quantity supplied rises from 1000 kg to 1400 kg, what is the price elasticity of supply?
qs.e: Percentage change in quantity = (400/1000)*100 = 40%. Percentage change in price = (50/200)*100 = 25%. Price Elasticity of Supply = 40% / 25% = 1.60.

qs.q: Which weed species is a free-floating aquatic plant that causes severe oxygen depletion and navigation obstruction in freshwater bodies?
qs.e: Eichhornia crassipes (water hyacinth) forms thick floating mats on water surfaces, blocking sunlight and depleting dissolved oxygen.

qs.q: Which method of irrigation delivers water directly to the plant root zone through small emitters at low pressure and frequent intervals?
qs.e: Drip (trickle) irrigation minimizes evaporation and drainage losses by applying water directly near plant roots via drippers.

qs.q: A farmer plants maize at a spacing of 75 cm by 25 cm with one plant per stand. How many maize plants will be present in a 1-hectare field?
qs.e: Area per stand = 0.75 m * 0.25 m = 0.1875 m2. Field area = 10,000 m2. Plant population = 10,000 / 0.1875 = 53,333 plants.

qs.q: Using Pearson square method, formulate a 20% crude protein feed mix using Maize (9% CP) and Soybean meal (44% CP). What percentage of the mix must be Soybean meal?
qs.e: Maize parts = |44 - 20| = 24. Soybean parts = |20 - 9| = 11. Total parts = 24 + 11 = 35. Soybean percentage = (11 / 35) * 100 = 31.4%.

qs.q: A soil sample has a bulk density of 1.325 g/cm3 and a particle density of 2.65 g/cm3. What is the percentage porosity of this soil?
qs.e: Porosity = (1 - Bulk density / Particle density) * 100 = (1 - 1.325 / 2.65) * 100 = (1 - 0.5) * 100 = 50.0%.

qs.q: What is the annual straight-line depreciation charge for a newly acquired farm tractor valued at 5,000,000 Naira with a 10-year lifespan and 500,000 Naira salvage value?
qs.e: Annual Depreciation = (Purchase Price - Salvage Value) / Lifespan = (5,000,000 - 500,000) / 10 = 4,500,000 / 10 = 450,000 Naira.

qs.q: Which bacterial disease of poultry causes swollen wattles, respiratory distress, greenish diarrhea, and high mortality in flock management?
qs.e: Fowl cholera is caused by Pasteurella multocida, characterized by swollen wattles, nasal discharge, and severe septicemia.

qs.q: A fish pond containing 5,000 tilapia with an average body weight of 200 g is fed at 3% of body biomass daily. How many kilograms of feed are required per day?
qs.e: Total biomass = 5,000 * 0.20 kg = 1,000 kg. Daily feed = 3% of 1,000 kg = 0.03 * 1,000 = 30 kg.

qs.q: In forest mensuration, calculate the basal area of a circular tree trunk with a diameter at breast height (DBH) of 0.4 meters.
Which component of the farm tractor hydraulic system converts fluid pressure generated by the hydraulic pump into mechanical force to raise linked implements?
qs.e: The hydraulic cylinder or ram converts pressurized fluid into linear mechanical movement to operate the three-point hitch linkage.

qs.q: If a feed mixture contains 60% dry matter and a sheep consumes 2.5 kg of fresh feed daily, how much dry matter intake does the sheep receive per day?
qs.e: Dry matter intake = Fresh weight consumed * Dry matter fraction = 2.5 kg * 0.60 = 1.50 kg.

qs.q: In crop breeding, what is the term used to describe the superior vigor and performance exhibited by F1 hybrid offspring over both parent lines?
qs.e: Heterosis (hybrid vigor) refers to the increased yield, growth rate, or robustness of crossbred offspring compared to purebred parents.

qs.q: Which soil structure type consists of vertical columns with rounded tops typically found in alkali subsoils rich in exchangeable sodium?
qs.e: Columnar structure features vertical pillars with rounded tops, characteristic of sodium-saturated (solonetzic) subsoil horizons.

qs.q: How many kilograms of Single Superphosphate fertilizer (18% P2O5) are required to apply 45 kg of P2O5 to a cassava plot?
qs.e: Fertilizer required = (Target nutrient weight / Percentage nutrient content) * 100 = (45 / 18) * 100 = 2.5 * 100 = 250 kg.

qs.q: In animal husbandry, the gestation period of a sow (female pig) is approximately:
qs.e: The gestation period of swine is approximately 114 days (commonly remembered as 3 months, 3 weeks, and 3 days).

qs.q: In production theory, which fundamental economic law describes the decrease in marginal output as variable factor units increase against fixed assets?
qs.e: The Law of Diminishing Returns dictates that beyond a certain point, equal increments of variable input yield smaller additional output.

qs.q: Which fungal disease of maize causes greyish-white blisters on stalks, leaves, and ears that burst to release black powdery spores?
qs.e: Maize smut is caused by the fungus Ustilago maydis, producing large galls/smut boils filled with dark teliospores.

qs.q: A broiler chicken consumes 4.5 kg of feed during its growth period and gains 2.25 kg of live body weight. Calculate the feed conversion ratio (FCR).
qs.e: Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR) = Total Feed Consumed / Weight Gain = 4.5 kg / 2.25 kg = 2.00.

qs.q: Calculate the cation exchange capacity (CEC) of a soil containing 4 meq/100g Ca2+, 2 meq/100g Mg2+, 0.5 meq/100g K+, 0.3 meq/100g Na+, and 1.2 meq/100g H+.
qs.e: Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) = Sum of exchangeable cations = 4 + 2 + 0.5 + 0.3 + 1.2 = 8.0 meq/100g of soil.

qs.q: A 2-hectare farm yields 8 metric tonnes of yam tubers. If total fixed cost is 200,000 Naira and variable cost per tonne is 30,000 Naira, what is total cost of production per tonne?
qs.e: Total Variable Cost = 8 * 30,000 = 240,000 Naira. Total Cost = 200,000 + 240,000 = 440,000 Naira. Cost per tonne = 440,000 / 8 = 55,000 Naira.

qs.q: If a spray rig equipped with 10 nozzles spaced 0.5 m apart travels at 6 km/h (100 m/min) and discharges 1.2 liters/min per nozzle, what is the application rate per hectare?
qs.e: Swath width = 10 * 0.5 m = 5 m. Area covered per min = 5 m * 100 m = 500 m2/min. Total discharge per min = 10 * 1.2 = 12 L/min. Rate per m2 = 12 / 500 = 0.024 L/m2. Rate per ha = 0.024 * 10,000 = 240 L/ha.

qs.q: A timber stand has 200 trees per hectare with an average basal area of 0.15 m2 and average height of 15 m. Assuming a form factor of 0.5, calculate total timber volume per hectare.
qs.e: Volume per tree = Basal area * Height * Form factor = 0.15 * 15 * 0.5 = 1.125 m3. Total volume per ha = 200 * 1.125 = 225 m3/ha.

qs.q: In a fish pond, dissolved oxygen was measured at 8 mg/L at 06:00 and 2 mg/L at 04:00 the next morning. What was the net oxygen consumption rate over 22 hours?
qs.e: Oxygen consumed = 8 - 2 = 6 mg/L over 22 hours. Consumption rate = 6 / 22 = 0.2727 mg/L/hour approx 0.27 mg/L/hour.

qs.q: A soil sample has a wet mass of 250 g and a oven-dry mass of 200 g. What is the gravimetric soil moisture content on a dry weight basis?
qs.e: Gravimetric moisture content = ((Wet mass - Dry mass) / Dry mass) * 100 = ((250 - 200) / 200) * 100 = (50 / 200) * 100 = 25.0%.

qs.q: Which hormonal change triggers parturition (whelping) in a pregnant bitch as progesterone levels sharply decrease?
o: Surge in luteinizing hormone from maternal pituitary gland
Rapid increase in progesterone from corpus luteum
Complete cessation of estrogen production by ovaries
Surge in cortisol from fetal adrenal glands inducing oxytocin and prostaglandin secretion
qs.e: Initiation of labor is driven by fetal stress raising ACTH and cortisol, causing luteolysis, falling progesterone, and rising prostaglandin F2-alpha and oxytocin.

qs.q: In plant pathology, what is the key difference between a biotrophic fungal pathogen and a necrotrophic fungal pathogen?
o: Biotrophs kill host cells immediately upon infection while necrotrophs require living host tissue.
Biotrophs attack roots while necrotrophs only attack leaves.
Biotrophs reproduce sexually while necrotrophs reproduce only asexually.
Biotrophs derive nutrients from living host cells while necrotrophs kill host cells and feed on dead tissue.
qs.e: Biotrophic fungi require viable host cells to absorb nutrients via haustoria, whereas necrotrophs secrete toxins and enzymes to kill host cells prior to colonization.

qs.q: Calculate the elasticity of demand when price of palm oil falls from 1000 Naira to 800 Naira per liter and quantity demanded increases from 50 liters to 70 liters.
qs.e: Percentage change in quantity = (20 / 50) * 100 = 40%. Percentage change in price = (200 / 1000) * 100 = 20%. Price Elasticity of Demand = 40% / 20% = 2.00.

qs.q: Which mechanism explains why dark-colored volcanic soils generally absorb more solar radiation but may remain cooler than lighter sandy soils under moist conditions?
o: Dark soils reflect shortwave solar radiation back into atmosphere.
Sandy soils contain zero quartz minerals to store thermal energy.
Volcanic soils generate endothermic chemical reactions continuously.
High water-holding capacity and specific heat capacity of wet volcanic soils buffer thermal change through evaporative cooling.
qs.e: Water has a high specific heat capacity (4.18 J/g deg C). Moist volcanic soils absorb thermal energy used in evaporating water rather than heating dry mineral particles.

qs.q: A soil core with internal volume 200 cm3 weighs 310 g when moist and 260 g after drying. If particle density is 2.60 g/cm3, calculate the percentage air-filled porosity of the moist soil.
qs.e: Total porosity = (1 - 1.30 / 2.60) * 100 = 50.0%. Volumetric water content = (310 - 260) / 200 = 50 cm3 / 200 cm3 = 25.0%. Air-filled porosity = Total porosity - Volumetric water = 50.0% - 25.0% = 25.0%.

qs.q: A dairy cow producing 20 kg of milk daily is fed a ration containing 16% Crude Protein (CP) and 70% Total Digestible Nutrients (TDN). If maintenance requires 0.5 kg CP and milk production requires 0.08 kg CP per kg milk, calculate the net surplus or deficit of CP if daily feed intake is 15 kg dry matter.
qs.e: CP intake = 15 kg * 0.16 = 2.40 kg CP. Total CP requirement = Maintenance (0.5 kg) + Production (20 * 0.08 = 1.60 kg) = 2.10 kg CP. Net balance = 2.40 - 2.10 = +0.30 kg CP surplus.

qs.q: A farm business balance sheet shows Current Assets of 1,200,000 Naira, Fixed Assets of 4,000,000 Naira, Current Liabilities of 600,000 Naira, and Long-term Liabilities of 1,800,000 Naira. Calculate the net capital ratio of the farm.
qs.e: Total Assets = 1,200,000 + 4,000,000 = 5,200,000 Naira. Total Liabilities = 600,000 + 1,800,000 = 2,400,000 Naira. Net Capital Ratio = Total Assets / Total Liabilities = 5,200,000 / 2,400,000 = 2.1667 approx 2.17.

qs.q: In an agro-forestry alley cropping system, hedgerows of Leucaena leucocephala spaced 4 m apart are pruned 3 times annually producing 6 metric tonnes of dry prunings per hectare per year containing 3.5% Nitrogen. Calculate the total kg of Nitrogen returned to the soil per hectare annually via prunings.
qs.e: Total prunings = 6,000 kg dry biomass. Nitrogen returned = 6,000 kg * 0.035 = 210 kg N per hectare per year.

qs.q: A re-circulating aquaculture system (RAS) stocking 10,000 catfish generates 15 kg of total ammonia nitrogen (TAN) daily. If the biofilter nitrification capacity is 0.5 g TAN per m2 of biofilter surface area per day, what biofilter surface area is required to process the TAN?
qs.e: TAN load = 15 kg = 15,000 g TAN/day. Biofilter area needed = 15,000 g / 0.5 g/m2/day = 30,000 m2.

qs.q: Which hand tool is specially designed with two sharp curved blades used for pruning small twigs and branches of fruit trees?
qs.e: Secateurs (pruning shears) feature bypass or anvil blades specifically for making clean cuts on small plant stems and twigs.

qs.q: What is the term for the forestry practice of planting trees to establish a new forest on land that was not previously forested?
qs.e: Afforestation refers to establishing a forest on land that has not contained trees for a long period or was never forested.

qs.q: Which soil component consists of fully decomposed, dark amorphous organic matter that improves soil cation exchange capacity and structure?
qs.e: Humus is stable, highly decomposed organic material that significantly enhances nutrient retention, moisture holding, and soil aggregation.

qs.q: Which anatomical structure in poultry stores consumed food temporarily before it enters the proventriculus for chemical digestion?
qs.e: The crop is an pouch-like expansion of the esophagus in birds used to store and moisten food before further digestion.

qs.q: Which viral disease of cocoa trees is transmitted by mealybugs (Planococcus species) and causes red vein banding on leaves and swollen shoots?
qs.e: Cocoa swollen shoot virus (CSSV) is transmitted by Pseudococcid mealybugs, causing swelling of stems, leaf chlorosis, and tree death.

qs.q: What is the primary method of propagating oil palm (Elaeis guineensis) seedlings for commercial plantation establishment?
qs.e: Oil palm is propagated sexually using high-yielding hybrid pre-germinated seeds nurtured in two-stage nurseries.

qs.q: In agricultural marketing, the movement of farm produce from rural farm sites to urban consumer markets is part of:
qs.e: The distribution (transportation) function physically moves agricultural commodities from centers of production to areas of consumption.

qs.q: What is the percent organic matter of a soil sample containing 3.2% total organic carbon, using the standard Bemmelen conversion factor of 1.724?
qs.e: Soil Organic Matter (%) = Total Organic Carbon (%) * 1.724 = 3.2 * 1.724 = 5.5168% approx 5.52%.

qs.q: Which nutrient element is essential for leguminous plants to synthesize leghnemoglobin and fix atmospheric nitrogen in root nodules?
qs.e: Molybdenum is a crucial cofactor for the nitrogenase enzyme complex and leghnemoglobin synthesis in Rhizobium root nodules.

qs.q: Which farm machine implement consists of concave steel discs arranged on axles used to pulverize plowed soil clods and incorporate crop residues?
qs.e: A disc harrow is a secondary tillage implement equipped with sets of rotating circular steel discs designed to pulverize and smooth plowed soil.

qs.q: Which soil property measures the relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay mineral particles present in a soil mass?
qs.e: Soil texture refers to the relative percentage distribution of sand, silt, and clay particles smaller than 2.0 mm in diameter.

qs.q: In sheep and goat husbandry, what is the term for the process of removing wool or hair around the tail and hindquarters to prevent flystrike?
qs.e: Dagging (or crutching) is trimming dags (soiled wool/hair) around the rear of sheep to reduce blowfly attraction and maggot infestation.

qs.q: Which fungal pathogen causes blast disease in rice crops, producing spindle-shaped lesions on leaf blades and nodes?
qs.e: Rice blast disease is caused by Pyricularia oryzae (Magnaporthe oryzae), creating characteristic eye-shaped or spindle-shaped leaf spots.

qs.q: A goat farm reports 12 kids born from 8 breeding does during one kidding season. What is the kidding percentage of the herd?
qs.e: Kidding percentage = (Number of kids born / Number of breeding does) * 100 = (12 / 8) * 100 = 150.0%.

qs.q: Which agro-forestry tree species is widely used in hedgerow intercropping in West Africa for its rapid growth, nitrogen-fixing ability, and high protein foliage?
qs.e: Gliricidia sepium is a fast-growing leguminous tree used extensively in alley cropping, living fences, and green manure production.

qs.q: Which parameter measures the clarity or cloudiness of fish pond water caused by suspended clay particles or plankton blooms?
qs.e: Turbidity measures light penetration in water; in fish culture, a Secchi disc is used to determine plankton density or clay siltation.

qs.q: Calculate the marginal physical product (MPP) when increasing fertilizer application from 50 kg to 70 kg increases total maize yield from 3000 kg to 3800 kg.
qs.e: Change in output = 3800 - 3000 = 800 kg. Change in input = 70 - 50 = 20 kg. MPP = 800 / 20 = 40 kg output per unit input.

qs.q: Which parasitic nematode species infects crop roots, forming characteristic root galls or knots that stunt plant growth?
qs.e: Meloidogyne species (root-knot nematodes) invade plant root tissues, inducing nurse cell formation and swollen galls.

qs.q: Which field practice involves growing legumes as a cover crop and plowing them into the soil while green to enhance soil organic matter?
qs.e: Green manuring involves cultivating fast-growing leguminous crops and incorporating their green succulent biomass into soil before flowering.

qs.q: A cassava farmer plants stem cuttings at a spacing of 1.0 m by 1.0 m. How many cassava plants will be cultivated on a 2.5-hectare land area?
qs.e: Area per stand = 1.0 m * 1.0 m = 1.0 m2. Total area = 2.5 * 10,000 m2 = 25,000 m2. Plant population = 25,000 / 1.0 = 25,000 plants.

qs.q: Formulate 100 kg of a 16% CP layer feed using Maize (9% CP) and Groundnut cake (45% CP). How many kg of Groundnut cake are required?
qs.e: Maize parts = |45 - 16| = 29. GNC parts = |16 - 9| = 7. Total parts = 36. GNC weight = (7 / 36) * 100 = 19.44 kg approx 19.4 kg.

qs.q: A soil core sample measuring 5 cm in radius and 10 cm in height has a dry weight of 1036 g. Calculate the bulk density of this soil.
qs.e: Volume = pi * r^2 * h = 3.1416 * 25 * 10 = 785.4 cm3. Bulk density = 1036 g / 785.4 cm3 = 1.319 g/cm3 approx 1.32 g/cm3.

qs.q: A farm storage facility purchased for 1,200,000 Naira depreciates at 10% per year using the declining balance method. What is its book value at the end of Year 2?
Which acute viral infection of swine causes high fever, cyanotic skin patches, internal hemorrhages, and nearly 100% mortality in domestic pigs?
qs.e: African swine fever (ASF) is an Asfarviridae viral disease causing severe hemorrhagic fever and extreme lethality in domestic pigs.

qs.q: Calculate the amount of lime (CaCO3 equivalent) needed to neutralize soil acidity in a 2-hectare farm if the soil requirement is 1.5 tonnes per hectare.
qs.e: Total lime required = Application rate * Hectares = 1.5 tonnes/ha * 2 ha = 3.0 tonnes.

qs.q: In agro-forestry, a shelterbelt constructed perpendicular to prevailing winds reduces wind speed over an agricultural area extending downwind up to:
o: 2 to 3 times the height of the trees
50 to 60 times the height of the trees
15 to 20 times the height of the trees
100 times the height of the trees
qs.e: A dense multi-row tree shelterbelt provides wind speed reduction downwind for a distance equal to 15 to 20 times the height (H) of the shelterbelt trees.

qs.q: Which power transmission mechanism on a tractor connects the flywheel to the transmission gearbox, allowing smooth engagement and disengagement of power?
qs.e: The clutch disengages the engine flywheel from the drive shaft to enable gear shifting and starting without stalling the engine.

qs.q: If a steer consumes 8 kg of dry matter daily containing 12% Crude Protein, how many grams of total crude protein does the steer consume per day?
qs.e: CP intake = 8 kg * 0.12 = 0.96 kg = 960 grams of crude protein daily.

qs.q: Which physiological process in high-yielding cereal crops causes stem bending or lodging prior to harvest when excessive nitrogen fertilizer is applied?
o: Stem elongation with weakened mechanical sclerenchyma tissue
qs.e: Over-fertilization with nitrogen promotes rapid vegetative extension and thin cell walls with poor lignification, leading to weak stems prone to lodging.

qs.q: Which secondary clay mineral has a 1:1 expanding lattice structure composed of one silica tetrahedral sheet and one alumina octahedral sheet?
qs.e: Kaolinite is a 1:1 non-expanding clay mineral bound tightly by hydrogen bonds between silica and alumina sheets.

qs.q: How many 50-kg bags of NPK 15-15-15 fertilizer are required to provide 30 kg of Nitrogen to a 1-hectare oil palm farm?
qs.e: NPK 15-15-15 contains 15% N. Total fertilizer weight needed = 30 / 0.15 = 200 kg. Number of 50-kg bags = 200 / 50 = 4 bags.

qs.q: What is the average length of the estrous cycle in mature cows (Bos taurus / Bos indicus)?
qs.e: The estrous cycle in cattle averages 21 days (with a range of 18 to 24 days) between estrus periods.

qs.q: Which agricultural market structure is characterized by a single buyer facing many competing agricultural producers?
qs.e: A monopsony is a market structure in which there is only one buyer (e.g. a state marketing board) for the outputs of many sellers.

qs.q: Which piercing-sucking insect pest damages cocoa pods by feeding on sap and injecting toxic saliva that causes necrotic spot lesions?
qs.e: Cocoa mirids (Sahlbergella singularis / Distantiella theobroma) feed on young pods and shoots, causing dieback and secondary fungal infections.

qs.q: A rabbit doe gives birth to 8 kits with a total litter birth weight of 480 g. At weaning (4 weeks), the total litter weight is 3,200 g. What is the total weight gain per kit during the suckling period?
qs.e: Total litter gain = 3200 - 480 = 2720 g. Weight gain per kit = 2720 / 8 = 340 grams.

qs.q: A 100g soil sample contains exchangeable bases: 3.0 meq Ca2+, 1.2 meq Mg2+, 0.4 meq K+, and 0.2 meq Na+. If CEC is 10 meq/100g, calculate the base saturation percentage.

A commercial poultry farm has total fixed costs of 500,000 Naira and variable cost per crate of eggs of 1,200 Naira. If eggs sell at 2,200 Naira per crate, calculate the break-even output volume in crates.
qs.e: Contribution margin per crate = 2,200 - 1,200 = 1,000 Naira. Break-even volume = Fixed costs / Contribution margin = 500,000 / 1,000 = 500 crates.

qs.q: A 4-bottom disc plow operates at 5 km/h. Each bottom cuts a width of 30 cm. If field efficiency is 80%, calculate the effective field capacity in hectares per hour.
qs.e: Working width = 4 * 0.3 m = 1.2 m. Theoretical capacity = (1.2 m * 5000 m/h) / 10,000 = 0.60 ha/h. Effective capacity = 0.60 * 0.80 = 0.48 ha/h.

qs.q: In a teak forest plantation, 400 trees per hectare with average basal area 0.20 m2 and height 20 m are harvested. Assuming form factor 0.45, calculate total wood volume harvested per hectare.
qs.e: Volume per tree = 0.20 * 20 * 0.45 = 1.80 m3. Total volume per ha = 400 * 1.80 = 720 m3/ha.

qs.q: In an intensive fish pond, 8,000 catfish with average weight 0.5 kg are fed a 42% protein diet at 2% body weight daily. What is total protein fed to the pond per day?
qs.e: Total biomass = 8,000 * 0.5 kg = 4,000 kg. Daily feed = 2% of 4,000 = 80 kg. Daily protein fed = 80 kg * 0.42 = 33.6 kg protein.

qs.q: A soil sample has a wet weight of 180 g, dry weight of 150 g, and total sample volume of 100 cm3. Calculate the volumetric water content of the soil sample.
qs.e: Mass of water = 180 - 150 = 30 g = 30 cm3 of water. Volumetric water content = (30 cm3 / 100 cm3) * 100 = 30.0%.

qs.q: Which specific anatomical adaptation enables ruminants to recycle systemic urea from blood into the rumen to support microbial protein synthesis under low-protein diets?
o: Biliary secretion through the bile duct into duodenum
Renal tubular reabsorption into the loop of Henle
Salivary secretion and direct transepithelial transport across the rumen wall
qs.e: Ruminants recycle endogenous urea via saliva and passive epithelial transport into the rumen, where urease-producing bacteria break it down into ammonia for bacterial amino acid synthesis.

qs.q: In plant protection, what is the chemical mode of action of systemic organophosphate insecticides like dimethoate?
o: Disruption of chitin synthesis during molting
Blockage of electron transport in mitochondrial complex I
Inhibition of cellulose synthesis in cell walls
Inhibition of acetylcholinesterase enzyme causing continuous nerve impulse transmission and paralysis
qs.e: Organophosphates irreversibly inhibit acetylcholinesterase (AChE), leading to accumulation of acetylcholine at synapses, hyper-excitation, and lethal neurotoxicity.

qs.q: Calculate the income elasticity of demand for beef when consumer income rises by 20% and beef consumption increases from 10 kg to 13 kg per month.
qs.e: Percentage change in quantity = (3 / 10) * 100 = 30%. Percentage change in income = 20%. Income elasticity = 30% / 20% = 1.50.

qs.q: Which thermodynamic principle explains why saturated clay soils warm up much slower in spring than dry coarse sandy soils?
o: Clay mineral surfaces have zero thermal conductivity.
Quartz sand grains emit infrared radiation continuously.
Organic matter in clay absorbs all thermal energy via endothermic chemical reactions.
High specific heat capacity of liquid water (4.18 J/g deg C) requires significantly more thermal energy per degree temperature rise.
qs.e: Water requires ~4.18 J/g C to raise its temperature compared to ~0.8 J/g C for dry mineral soil solids, making wet clay thermally inert relative to dry sand.

qs.q: A soil profile has a bulk density of 1.40 g/cm3 and particle density of 2.65 g/cm3. If gravimetric moisture content is 20%, calculate the percentage volume of soil air at field capacity.
qs.e: Total porosity = (1 - 1.40 / 2.65) * 100 = 47.17%. Volumetric water content = Gravimetric moisture * Bulk density = 20% * 1.40 = 28.0%. Air volume = 47.17% - 28.0% = 19.17% approx 19.2%.

qs.q: A lactating ewe weighs 60 kg and requires 0.20 kg CP for maintenance plus 0.12 kg CP per liter of milk produced. If the ewe yields 1.5 liters of milk daily and consumes 2.0 kg of dry matter daily, what minimum percentage Crude Protein must the feed ration contain on a dry matter basis?
qs.e: Total CP required = Maintenance (0.20) + Milk (1.5 * 0.12 = 0.18) = 0.38 kg CP daily. Required CP percentage = (0.38 kg / 2.0 kg DM) * 100 = 19.0%.

qs.q: A cocoa farmer invests 2,000,000 Naira in expanding his plantation. Annual net cash inflows are 600,000 Naira for 5 consecutive years. At a discount rate of 10%, calculate the Net Present Value (NPV) using the discount factors: Y1=0.909, Y2=0.826, Y3=0.751, Y4=0.683, Y5=0.621 (Sum = 3.790).
qs.e: Present Value of Inflows = 600,000 * 3.790 = 2,274,000 Naira. NPV = PV of Inflows - Initial Investment = 2,274,000 - 2,000,000 = +274,000 Naira.

qs.q: An agro-forestry taungya plantation of Terminalia superba planted at 5 m by 5 m spacing receives an application of rock phosphate (30% P2O5) at 200 g per tree. Calculate total metric tonnes of rock phosphate required for a 20-hectare plantation.
qs.e: Trees per hectare = 10,000 / (5 * 5) = 400 trees/ha. Total trees for 20 ha = 400 * 20 = 8,000 trees. Fertilizer per tree = 0.200 kg. Total fertilizer = 8,000 * 0.200 = 1,600 kg = 1.6 metric tonnes.

qs.q: A semi-intensive fish culture facility with a total water volume of 500 m3 experiences an inflow of toxic un-ionized ammonia (NH3) at 0.05 mg/L. If complete biological conversion by Nitrosomonas and Nitrobacter occurs at a rate of 0.01 mg/L/hour, how many hours are required to reduce toxic NH3 to zero assuming no further inputs?
qs.e: Time required = Initial Concentration / Nitrification Rate = 0.05 mg/L / 0.01 mg/L/hour = 5 hours.

qs.q: Which hand tool consists of a flat iron blade attached at a right angle to a wooden handle, used for ridging, weeding, and digging?
qs.e: The West African hand hoe features a steel blade set perpendicularly to a wooden shaft, suitable for soil tillage and weed control.

qs.q: In agro-forestry, the practice of growing rows of arable crops between hedgerows of nitrogen-fixing trees or shrubs is known as:
qs.e: Alley cropping (hedgerow intercropping) involves cultivating annual crops in the alleys formed by hedgerows of woody legumes.

qs.q: Which macro-nutrient is primarily responsible for promoting vigorous root development and early floral initiation in crop plants?
qs.e: Phosphorus is critical for cellular energy transfer (ATP) and promotes rapid root proliferation and early crop reproductive maturation.

qs.q: Which common species of freshwater fish cultivated in Nigerian aquaculture ponds belongs to the Cichlidae family and feeds mainly on plankton?
qs.e: Oreochromis niloticus (Nile tilapia) is a cichlid teleost fish adapted to feeding on phytoplankton, detritus, and pelleted feed in tropical ponds.

qs.q: Which protozoan parasite causes avian coccidiosis in poultry, characterized by bloody diarrhea, emaciation, and destruction of intestinal epithelial cells?
qs.e: Eimeria tenella is an apicomplexan protozoan that colonizes ceca in chickens, destroying mucosa and causing severe cecal coccidiosis.

qs.q: What is the principal method of propagating white yam (Dioscorea rotundata) vegetatively on smallholder farms?
qs.e: Yams are propagated vegetatively using seed tubers or cut yam setts weighing between 200 g and 400 g.

qs.q: In farm management, variable costs are best defined as production costs that:
o: vary directly with the volume of farm output produced.
remain constant regardless of production level.
equal net revenue at all times.
qs.e: Variable costs (e.g. seeds, fertilizer, feed, labor) fluctuate in direct proportion to the scale or level of farm production.

qs.q: Calculate the percentage moisture content of a fresh forage sample weighing 500 g that yields 125 g of dry matter after oven drying.
qs.e: Moisture content = ((Fresh weight - Dry weight) / Fresh weight) * 100 = ((500 - 125) / 500) * 100 = (375 / 500) * 100 = 75.0%.

qs.q: Which bacterial genus forms symbiotic nitrogen-fixing root nodules on leguminous crops like cowpea and groundnut?
qs.e: Rhizobium bacteria establish endosymbiotic associations inside root nodules of legumes, converting atmospheric N2 into plant-usable ammonia.

qs.q: Which tractor implement features curved vertical tines with spring assistance used for breaking surface soil crusts and eradicating weeds?
qs.e: A spring-tooth cultivator uses flexible steel tines to break up surface crusts, aerate topsoil, and uproot seedling weeds.

qs.q: What is the dominant clay mineral in highly weathered, reddish tropical oxisols and ultisols that exhibits low CEC and minimal swelling?
qs.e: Kaolinite is a 1:1 non-expanding aluminosilicate clay mineral dominant in highly leached, acidic tropical soils.

qs.q: In poultry management, what is the practice of trimming the upper beak of laying hens to prevent cannibalism and feather pecking called?
qs.e: Debeaking (beak trimming) involves cauterizing a portion of the upper beak in pullets to control injurious feather pecking and egg eating.

qs.q: Which viral disease of cassava transmitted by the whitefly Bemisia tabaci causes yellow mosaic mottling and leaf distortion?
qs.e: Cassava mosaic begomovirus is vectored by whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci), producing characteristic chlorotic mosaic patterns and yield losses.

qs.q: A lamb weighs 4.0 kg at birth and achieves a body weight of 28.0 kg at 120 days of age. Calculate the average daily weight gain (ADG).
qs.e: Total weight gain = 28.0 - 4.0 = 24.0 kg = 24,000 g. ADG = 24,000 g / 120 days = 200 grams per day.

qs.q: The agro-forestry practice of planting dense rows of trees along field perimeters to shield crops and soil from high wind erosion is called:
qs.e: Windbreaks (shelterbelts) consist of linear plantings of trees and shrubs designed to reduce wind speed, soil erosion, and evapotranspiration.

qs.q: What is the recommended range of dissolved oxygen concentration in a tropical catfish pond to support optimal feed digestion and health?
qs.e: Optimal dissolved oxygen for warm-water teleost fish culture is between 5.0 and 8.0 mg/L; levels below 2.0 mg/L cause severe hypoxia distress.

qs.q: If the total revenue from selling 200 crates of eggs is 440,000 Naira and total production cost is 300,000 Naira, calculate the net profit per crate.
qs.e: Total net profit = 440,000 - 300,000 = 140,000 Naira. Net profit per crate = 140,000 / 200 = 700 Naira.

qs.q: Which parasitic weed species attaches to maize and sorghum root systems via haustoria, stealing nutrients and suppressing host growth?
qs.e: Striga hermonthica (witchweed) is an obligate root hemiparasite that infects cereal crops, severely reducing grain yields in sub-Saharan Africa.

qs.q: Which cultural farm practice involves covering the soil surface around plants with organic residue like straw or wood shavings to conserve moisture?
qs.e: Mulching reduces soil evaporation, suppresses weed growth, moderates topsoil temperature, and enriches soil organic matter upon decay.

qs.q: A maize farmer plants seeds at a spacing of 0.80 m by 0.25 m with one seed per hill. Calculate the total plant population on a 1.5-hectare plot.
qs.e: Area per stand = 0.80 m * 0.25 m = 0.20 m2. Field area = 1.5 * 10,000 = 15,000 m2. Plant population = 15,000 / 0.20 = 75,000 plants.

qs.q: Formulate 200 kg of a 14% CP pig grower ration using Maize (9% CP) and Concentrate mix (34% CP). How many kg of Maize are required?
qs.e: Maize parts = |34 - 14| = 20. Concentrate parts = |14 - 9| = 5. Total parts = 25. Maize weight = (20 / 25) * 200 = 160 kg.

qs.q: A soil core sample measuring 100 cm3 in volume weighs 150 g moist and 125 g after complete drying. Calculate the particle density if porosity is 52.8%.
qs.e: Bulk density = 125 g / 100 cm3 = 1.25 g/cm3. Porosity = 1 - (Bulk density / Particle density) => 0.528 = 1 - (1.25 / Pd) => Particle density = 1.25 / (1 - 0.528) = 1.25 / 0.472 = 2.648 approx 2.65 g/cm3.

qs.q: What is the salvage value of a grain grinder purchased for 400,000 Naira that depreciates by 35,000 Naira annually over a 10-year lifespan under straight-line method?
qs.e: Total depreciation = 10 * 35,000 = 350,000 Naira. Salvage value = Purchase price - Total depreciation = 400,000 - 350,000 = 50,000 Naira.

qs.q: Which acute viral disease of cattle causes vesicular blisters on mouth, tongue, teats, and interdigital clefts of hooves, leading to lameness and salivation?
qs.e: Foot and mouth disease (FMD) is an Aphthovirus infection causing painful vesicles on oral mucosa and feet of cloven-hoofed ruminants.

qs.q: A fish farmer stocks an earthen pond measuring 20 m by 25 m with catfish fingerlings at a stocking density of 8 fish/m2. How many fingerlings are needed?
qs.e: Pond area = 20 m * 25 m = 500 m2. Fingerlings required = 500 m2 * 8 fish/m2 = 4,000 fingerlings.

qs.q: In forest management, what is the annual allowable cut (AAC) calculated for a 500-hectare timber plantation with a total standing volume of 50,000 m3 and a 25-year rotation period?
qs.e: Annual Allowable Cut (AAC) = Total standing volume / Rotation period = 50,000 m3 / 25 years = 2,000 m3 per year.

qs.q: Which part of the tractor power take-off (PTO) drive shaft transmits mechanical energy at flexible working angles using cross-shaped spider journal bearings?
qs.e: Universal joints (U-joints) allow the PTO shaft to transfer rotational power flexibly while the tractor and implement move over uneven terrain.

qs.q: If a goat consumes 3.0 kg of fresh browse containing 40% dry matter, how many kilograms of dry matter does the goat consume?
qs.e: Dry matter intake = Fresh weight * Dry matter percentage = 3.0 kg * 0.40 = 1.20 kg.

qs.q: In plant physiology, what is the primary tissue through which manufactured sucrose and organic nutrients are translocated from source leaves to sink organs?
qs.e: Phloem sieve tubes transport assimilates (photosynthates) via pressure flow from source organs to metabolic sinks like roots and tubers.

qs.q: Which soil property measures the resistance of soil aggregates to mechanical deformation or rupture under applied pressure across varying moisture conditions?
qs.e: Soil consistency describes the degree of cohesion and adhesion of soil mass (e.g. friable, plastic, hard) at dry, moist, or wet states.

qs.q: How many kilograms of Urea fertilizer (46% N) are required to supply 92 kg of Nitrogen to a 2-hectare maize farm?
qs.e: Urea required = (Target N weight / Percentage N) * 100 = (92 / 46) * 100 = 2 * 100 = 200 kg.

qs.q: In poultry physiology, how many hours does it take on average for a hen to form and lay a complete hard-shelled egg?
qs.e: Egg formation in chickens takes approximately 24.5 to 26 hours, with shell deposition in the uterus requiring the longest duration (~20 hours).

qs.q: Which economic term describes a government policy that sets a minimum legal price for an agricultural commodity above market equilibrium to protect farmer incomes?
qs.e: A price floor is a legally established minimum price set above equilibrium to guarantee fair returns to agricultural producers.

qs.q: Which fungal pathogen causes damping-off disease in vegetable nursery beds, causing seedling collapse at the soil surface level?
qs.e: Pythium species infect seedling stems near soil line under high moisture, dissolving cell walls and causing rapid damping-off collapse.

qs.q: A bull consumes 10 kg of feed dry matter containing 1.8 kg Crude Protein (CP) daily. The fecal output is 3.5 kg dry matter containing 0.45 kg CP. Calculate the apparent digestibility coefficient of CP.
qs.e: Apparent CP Digestibility = ((CP intake - Fecal CP) / CP intake) * 100 = ((1.8 - 0.45) / 1.8) * 100 = (1.35 / 1.8) * 100 = 75.0%.

qs.q: A soil contains 2.5 meq Ca2+, 1.0 meq Mg2+, 0.3 meq K+, 0.2 meq Na+, and 4.0 meq H+ and Al3+ per 100g. What is the effective cation exchange capacity (ECEC) of this soil?
qs.e: ECEC = Sum of exchangeable bases + exchangeable acidity = (2.5 + 1.0 + 0.3 + 0.2) + 4.0 = 4.0 + 4.0 = 8.0 meq/100g of soil.

qs.q: Calculate the marginal cost (MC) when increasing cassava production from 10 tonnes to 15 tonnes causes total cost to increase from 250,000 Naira to 400,000 Naira.
qs.e: Change in total cost = 400,000 - 250,000 = 150,000 Naira. Change in output = 15 - 10 = 5 tonnes. Marginal Cost = 150,000 / 5 = 30,000 Naira per tonne.

qs.q: A tractor pulling a 3-bottom disc plow operates at a speed of 6 km/h. If total working width is 90 cm and field efficiency is 75%, calculate effective field capacity in ha/h.
qs.e: Theoretical capacity = (0.90 m * 6000 m/h) / 10,000 = 0.54 ha/h. Effective capacity = 0.54 * 0.75 = 0.405 ha/h.

qs.q: A forest reserve containing 150 mahogany trees per hectare has an average DBH of 0.6 m and commercial trunk height of 12 m. Assuming form factor 0.5, calculate timber volume per hectare.
qs.e: Basal area = pi * (0.3)^2 = 0.2827 m2. Tree volume = 0.2827 * 12 * 0.5 = 1.696 m3. Total volume per ha = 150 * 1.696 = 254.47 m3/ha approx 254.5 m3/ha.

qs.q: In a tilapia pond of volume 1000 m3, un-ionized ammonia is 0.08 mg/L. What total mass of un-ionized ammonia in grams is present in the pond volume?
qs.e: Total mass = Concentration * Volume = 0.08 mg/L * 1000 m3 = 0.08 g/m3 * 1000 m3 = 80 grams.

qs.q: A soil core with volume 150 cm3 weighs 225 g when moist and 195 g dry. Calculate the volumetric water content of the soil sample.
qs.e: Mass of water = 225 - 195 = 30 g = 30 cm3. Volumetric water content = (30 cm3 / 150 cm3) * 100 = 20.0%.

qs.q: Which metabolic pathway in ruminant liver tissue converts microbially produced propionic acid into glucose to meet host metabolic energy requirements?
qs.e: Propionate absorbed from the rumen is transported to the liver and converted into glucose via gluconeogenesis, providing up to 60% of systemic glucose in ruminants.

qs.q: In weed science, what is the physiological mode of action of non-selective systemic herbicides like glyphosate?
o: Inhibition of photosystem II electron transport
Disruption of microtubule assembly during mitosis
Inhibition of EPSP synthase enzyme blocking aromatic amino acid synthesis in the shikimate pathway
qs.e: Glyphosate inhibits 5-enolpyruvylshikimate-3-phosphate (EPSP) synthase, preventing synthesis of essential aromatic amino acids (phenylalanine, tyrosine, tryptophan).

qs.q: Calculate the cross-price elasticity of demand between maize and sorghum when a 10% increase in maize price causes sorghum demand to increase by 15%.
qs.e: Cross-price elasticity = (% change in Q_sorghum) / (% change in P_maize) = +15% / +10% = +1.50 (indicating substitute goods).

qs.q: Which soil physics phenomenon describes the rapid downward movement of water and dissolved solutes through large continuous macropores bypassing the soil matrix?
qs.e: Preferential flow allows water and agrochemicals to migrate rapidly through root channels, earthworm burrows, or soil cracks without equilibrating with the soil matrix.

qs.q: A undisturbed soil sample has a bulk density of 1.35 g/cm3, particle density of 2.70 g/cm3, and gravimetric moisture content of 15%. Calculate the percentage volume of soil air.
qs.e: Total porosity = (1 - 1.35 / 2.70) * 100 = 50.0%. Volumetric water content = 15% * 1.35 = 20.25%. Percentage air volume = 50.0% - 20.25% = 29.75%.

qs.q: A beef steer weighing 350 kg has a daily dry matter intake capacity of 3% of body weight. The ration provides 12% CP and 68% TDN. If maintenance requires 0.45 kg CP and 3.2 kg TDN daily, calculate the daily net CP available for tissue gain.
qs.e: Daily DM intake = 0.03 * 350 = 10.5 kg DM. Total CP intake = 10.5 * 0.12 = 1.26 kg CP. CP available for gain = 1.26 - 0.45 = +0.81 kg CP.

qs.q: A commercial poultry venture has total assets of 8,000,000 Naira and total liabilities of 3,200,000 Naira. Calculate the debt-to-equity ratio of the farm.
qs.e: Owner Equity = Total Assets - Total Liabilities = 8,000,000 - 3,200,000 = 4,800,000 Naira. Debt-to-Equity Ratio = Total Liabilities / Equity = 3,200,000 / 4,800,000 = 0.6667 approx 0.67.

qs.q: In an agro-forestry silvopastoral system stocking 20 cattle on 25 hectares, annual forage production is 4 metric tonnes DM/ha. If cattle consume 7.5 kg DM daily per head, calculate the net annual forage surplus or deficit.
qs.e: Total forage produced = 25 ha * 4 t/ha = 100 t = 100,000 kg DM. Annual cattle intake = 20 * 7.5 kg * 365 = 54,750 kg DM = 54.75 t. Surplus = 100 t - 54.75 t = +45.25 t DM surplus.

qs.q: A catfish hatchery with 20 incubation tanks holding 500 liters of water each requires a complete water turnover every 2 hours. What minimum total pump flow rate in liters per minute (L/min) is required for the hatchery system?
qs.e: Total system volume = 20 * 500 = 10,000 liters. Turnover time = 2 hours = 120 minutes. Flow rate required = 10,000 L / 120 min = 83.33 L/min.

qs.q: Which farm tool consists of a metal basin supported by two handles and a single front wheel, used for transporting farm inputs and harvested produce?
qs.e: A wheelbarrow is a single-wheeled hand-propelled vehicle designed to distribute load weight evenly between the wheel and operator.

qs.q: What is the term for the forestry management system in which logged forest areas are allowed to regenerate naturally from dormant seeds and root suckers?
qs.e: Natural regeneration relies on self-sown seeds, lignotubers, or root suckers to re-establish forest cover without human planting.

qs.q: Which soil order is characterized by dark, organic-rich topsoil formed primarily under grassland vegetation with high base saturation?
qs.e: Mollisols are prairie and grassland soils featuring a thick mollic epipedon rich in organic carbon and exchangeable calcium/magnesium.

qs.q: Which organ in the avian digestive tract contains ingested small stones (grit) and uses thick muscular walls to grind tough grains mechanically?
qs.e: The gizzard or ventriculus uses powerful muscular contractions and ingested grit to mechanically crush and grind fibrous food particles.

qs.q: Which fungal disease of tomato and potato crops causes severe foliar lesions with pale halo rings and rapid stem blighting during humid weather?
qs.e: Late blight caused by Phytophthora infestans is an oomycete disease that destroys foliage and tubers rapidly under cool humid conditions.

qs.q: What is the primary method of propagating sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas) commercially in tropical agriculture?
qs.e: Sweet potatoes are propagated vegetatively using apical or stem vine cuttings bearing 3 to 5 nodes.

qs.q: In agricultural economics, the market equilibrium price is established at the price level where:
o: total revenue exceeds total cost by peak profit.
qs.e: Market equilibrium occurs at the intersection of demand and supply curves where quantity demanded matches quantity supplied.

qs.q: Calculate the crude protein percentage of a feed ingredient containing 3.2% Nitrogen by weight, using the standard Kjeldahl conversion factor of 6.25.
qs.e: Crude Protein (%) = Total Nitrogen (%) * 6.25 = 3.2 * 6.25 = 20.0%.

qs.q: Which group of free-living aerobic soil bacteria fixes atmospheric nitrogen non-symbiotically in arable soils?
qs.e: Azotobacter species are heterotrophic aerobic free-living bacteria that fix atmospheric nitrogen independently in well-aerated soils.

qs.q: Which tractor attachment uses revolving steel flails or blades powered by the PTO shaft to cut thick brush and heavy weeds on uncultivated land?
qs.e: A rotary slasher utilizes heavy rotating steel blades driven by the PTO to clear dense vegetation, bush, and heavy grass stubble.

qs.q: Which physical property of soil refers to the arrangement of primary sand, silt, and clay particles into secondary aggregate peds?
qs.e: Soil structure describes how individual mineral soil particles bind together into distinct aggregates or peds (e.g. granular, blocky, platy).

qs.q: In pig farming, what is the term for the artificial or natural removal of young piglets from the sow to transition them to solid feed rations?
qs.e: Weaning is the separation of nursing piglets from the sow, typically conducted between 21 and 28 days of age in commercial swine units.

qs.q: Which bacterial disease of cassava causes angular leaf spots, gum exudation on stems, systemic wilting, and severe defoliation?
qs.e: Cassava bacterial blight caused by Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. manihotis induces water-soaked angular leaf spots and vascular wilting.

qs.q: A poultry flock of 500 laying hens produces 420 eggs on a specific day. Calculate the hen-day egg production percentage of the flock.
qs.e: Hen-day production (%) = (Total eggs laid / Number of live hens) * 100 = (420 / 500) * 100 = 84.0%.

qs.q: Which agro-forestry tree species is famous for producing high-quality durable hardwood timber resistant to termites and fungal decay in tropical zones?
qs.e: Teak (Tectona grandis) yields dense, oil-rich hardwood with exceptional resistance to weather, rot, and termite attack.

qs.q: What is the standard chemical used by fish farmers during pond preparation to neutralize soil acidity and eliminate parasites before stocking?
qs.e: Liming with CaCO3 or Ca(OH)2 raises pond bottom pH, increases total alkalinity, and acts as a disinfectant prior to filling.

qs.q: Calculate the total interest due on an agricultural loan of 500,000 Naira borrowed for 2 years at a simple interest rate of 8% per annum.
qs.e: Simple Interest = Principal * Rate * Time = 500,000 * 0.08 * 2 = 80,000 Naira.

qs.q: Which insect pest of stored cowpeas lays eggs on dry seed coats whose larvae bore inside, consuming endosperm and leaving circular emergence holes?
qs.e: Callosobruchus maculatus (cowpea weevil/bruchid) is a major post-harvest pest of pulse grains in tropical storage structures.

qs.q: Which agronomic practice involves removing excess weak or overcrowded crop seedlings from a row to maintain optimal plant spacing and reduce competition?
qs.e: Thinning selectively removes weak or crowded seedlings shortly after emergence to achieve recommended stand spacing.

qs.q: A farmer plants cowpea at a spacing of 50 cm by 20 cm with two plants per stand. How many cowpea plants will occupy a 0.5-hectare plot?
qs.e: Area per stand = 0.50 m * 0.20 m = 0.10 m2. Field area = 0.5 * 10,000 = 5,000 m2. Stands = 5,000 / 0.10 = 50,000 stands. Plants = 50,000 * 2 = 100,000 plants.

qs.q: Using Pearson square, calculate the kg of Wheat offal (16% CP) and Fish meal (65% CP) required to make 100 kg of a 20% CP poultry finisher feed.
o: 80.0 kg Wheat offal and 20.0 kg Fish meal
91.8 kg Wheat offal and 8.2 kg Fish meal
50.0 kg Wheat offal and 50.0 kg Fish meal
85.0 kg Wheat offal and 15.0 kg Fish meal
qs.e: Wheat offal parts = |65 - 20| = 45. Fish meal parts = |20 - 16| = 4. Total parts = 49. Wheat offal = (45 / 49) * 100 = 91.84 kg. Fish meal = (4 / 49) * 100 = 8.16 kg.

qs.q: If a farmer applies 200 kg of NPK 15-15-15 fertilizer to a farm, how many kilograms of actual nitrogen (N) are supplied to the soil?
qs.e: NPK 15-15-15 contains 15% N. Nitrogen supplied = 200 kg * 0.15 = 30 kg N.

qs.q: A knapsack sprayer has a tank capacity of 15 liters and covers 250 m2 per full tank. How many full tanks are required to spray a 1-hectare field?
qs.e: Field area = 10,000 m2. Tanks required = 10,000 m2 / 250 m2 = 40 full tanks.

qs.q: What is the primary physiological cause of bloat (tympanites) in ruminant livestock grazing on lush leguminous pastures?
o: Bacterial infection of the abomasum lining
Trapping of fermentation gases in stable foam within the rumen
Blockage of the omasum by coarse fibrous material
Excessive accumulation of lactic acid in the cecum
qs.e: Bloat occurs when soluble pasture proteins form stable foam in the rumen that traps gas, preventing normal eructation (burping).

qs.q: Which parasitic flowering plant attaches to the roots of cereal crops like sorghum and maize, absorbing nutrients and causing severe stunting?
qs.e: Striga hermonthica is a obligate root hemiparasite that infects cereal crops, severely reducing yields in semi-arid regions.

qs.q: In aquaculture, what term describes the sudden depletion of dissolved oxygen in fish ponds caused by mass die-offs of dense algal blooms during warm overcast days?
qs.e: When dense microalgal blooms collapse, microbial decomposition consumes dissolved oxygen rapidly, causing severe pond anoxia and fish kills.

qs.q: A farm tractor purchased for 4,000,000 Naira has a salvage value of 400,000 Naira after 10 years. Calculate its annual depreciation using the straight-line method.
qs.e: Annual Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage Value) / Useful Life = (4,000,000 - 400,000) / 10 = 360,000 Naira.

qs.q: Which silvicultural practice involves cutting down mature trees close to ground level to stimulate vigorous growth of multiple new shoots from the stump?
qs.e: Coppicing is a traditional forestry technique where tree stems are cut near ground level to produce a crop of new poles or stems from dormant buds.

qs.q: Which disease of poultry is caused by a paramyxovirus, manifesting as respiratory distress, greenish diarrhea, and torticollis (twisted neck)?
qs.e: Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection affecting poultry respiratory, digestive, and nervous systems (causing torticollis).

qs.q: In soil chemistry, the cation exchange capacity (CEC) of soil is defined as:
o: the rate of anion leaching through the subsoil horizon.
the percentage of soil volume occupied by water and air.
the total capacity of a soil to hold exchangeable positively charged ions.
the total acidity measured by active hydrogen ion concentration.
qs.e: CEC measures the total quantity of exchangeable cations (like Ca2+, Mg2+, K+, Na+) that a soil can retain on negative clay and humus surfaces.

qs.q: Which vegetative propagation method involves wrapping a wounded stem segment with moist sphagnum moss and plastic foil while still attached to the parent plant?
qs.e: Air layering or marcotting encourages adventitious root formation on an intact stem segment enclosed in moist medium and moisture-proof wrap.

qs.q: Which component of a disc plough enables the concave steel discs to rotate smoothly as they penetrate and turn over heavy clay soils?
o: Tapered roller bearings in the disc hub
qs.e: Tapered roller bearings within the disc hub allow free rotation under high draft and side-thrust forces as the disc cuts soil.

qs.q: An agricultural market analyst notes that a 10% increase in the price of maize leads to a 15% decrease in quantity demanded. Calculate the price elasticity of demand for maize.
qs.e: Price Elasticity of Demand = (% Change in Quantity Demanded) / (% Change in Price) = 15% / 10% = 1.5.

qs.q: Which freshwater fish species commonly cultivated in West Africa is an air-breathing catfish possessing an accessory supracranchial organ for atmospheric oxygen intake?
qs.e: Clarias gariepinus possesses a arborescent organ allowing it to breathe atmospheric oxygen and survive in low-oxygen waters.

qs.q: Calculate the bulk density of a core soil sample with a dry mass of 390 grams and a total cylinder core volume of 300 cubic centimeters.
qs.e: Bulk Density = Mass of oven-dry soil / Total soil volume = 390 g / 300 cm3 = 1.30 g/cm3.

qs.q: A broiler feed formula requires 45% maize (containing 9% CP) and 55% soybean meal (containing 44% CP). Calculate the overall crude protein percentage of this two-ingredient blend.
qs.e: Contribution from Maize = 0.45 * 9% = 4.05%. Contribution from Soybean = 0.55 * 44% = 24.20%. Total CP = 4.05% + 24.20% = 28.25%.

qs.q: If a farmer plants oil palm at a triangular spacing of 9 meters by 9 meters, how many oil palm seedlings are required to plant 2 hectares of land?
qs.e: For triangular spacing s = 9 m: Area per tree = s^2 * sin(60 deg) = 81 * 0.866025 = 70.15 m2. Field area = 2 * 10,000 = 20,000 m2. Seedlings = 20,000 / 70.15 = 285.1 -> 286 seedlings.

qs.q: Which thermodynamic process describes the downward movement of water-soluble plant nutrients below the root zone through gravitational water percolation?
qs.e: Leaching is the loss of soluble cations and anions (like nitrate and potassium) carried down through soil layers by drainage water.

qs.q: In animal reproductive physiology, what hormone is produced by the corpus luteum to maintain pregnancy and suppress estrus cycles in livestock?
qs.e: Progesterone secreted by the corpus luteum maintains the uterine lining and prevents ovulation during gestation.

qs.q: Calculate the Net Present Value (NPV) of an agricultural investment with an initial outlay of 100,000 Naira and cash inflows of 60,000 Naira at year 1 and 60,000 Naira at year 2, discounted at 10%.
Which internal parasite of ruminants completes its indirect life cycle involving Lymnaea aquatic snails as intermediate hosts, causing liver rot?
qs.e: Fasciola hepatica (liver fluke) uses freshwater snails (Lymnaea spp.) as intermediate hosts before encysting on vegetation ingested by livestock.

qs.q: In tractor transmission systems, what component allows the drive wheels on the outer side of a turn to rotate faster than the inner wheels during turning?
qs.e: The differential permits outer driving wheels to rotate faster than inner wheels while negotiating curves, preventing axle stress and tire scuffing.

qs.q: What is the standard seeding rate calculation formula for determining pure live seed (PLS) percentage of a crop seed batch?
qs.e: Pure Live Seed (PLS) percentage measures seed quality as the product of purity percentage and germination percentage divided by 100.

qs.q: Which silvopastoral system integrates fast-growing nitrogen-fixing leguminous trees arranged in hedgerows with herbaceous forage grasses harvested for livestock cut-and-carry fodder?
qs.e: Alley farming involves growing crops or forage grasses in alleys between hedgerows of nitrogen-fixing trees (e.g. Leucaena or Gliricidia).

qs.q: In commercial catfish hatchery operations, what hormone injection treatment is commonly administered to female gravid broodstock to induce oocyte maturation and ovulation?
qs.e: Intramuscular injection of pituitary extract or synthetic gonadotropin-releasing hormone (Ovaprim) triggers final maturation and spawning in catfish.
